lines.en: Hey, wouldn't it be cool if our duck and our chick had a little baby?
I was in the shower, and as I was cleansing myself, I, well, I felt something.
Was it like a sneeze, only better?
No, no, I mean, I mean, like, a thing on my body.
It's, it's kind of in a place that's not, it's not visually accessible to me,
and I was hoping maybe you guys could, could help me out.
Come on, you guys, no big deal.
Just go, hey, hey, hey, hey.
No, it's too wrinkly to be a mole.
Well, ew, is it, what, a pimple?
No, it's fancier than a pimple.
Look, Ross, why don't you just go see a duck?
